51: // ANCHOR: transpose_impl
52: // `D: MaterializableScalar` (see its doc) excludes i5/i9 stagings from transpose.
53: impl<
54:     'l,
55:     const T: Tu,
56:     P: CanApplyTranspose,
57:     D: MaterializableScalar,
58:     Chip: M,
59:     Cluster: M,
60:     Slice: M,
61:     Time: M,
62:     Packet: M,
63:     B: Backend,
64: > TuTensor<'l, T, P, D, Chip, Cluster, Slice, Time, Packet, B>
65: {
66:     /// Performs the transpose operation.
67:     #[primitive(TuTensor::transpose)]
68:     pub fn transpose<OutTime: M, OutPacket: M>(
69:         self,
70:     ) -> TransposeTensor<'l, T, D, Chip, Cluster, Slice, OutTime, OutPacket, B> {
71:         verify_transpose::<D, Time, Packet, OutTime, OutPacket>();
72:         TransposeTensor::new(self.device, self.inner.transpose(false))
73:     }
74: }
75: // ANCHOR_END: transpose_impl
76: 
77: /// Verifies that the transpose engine can produce `(OutTime, OutPacket)`.
78: pub(crate) fn verify_transpose<D: Scalar, Time: M, Packet: M, OutTime: M, OutPacket: M>() {
79:     config_transpose(TransposeInput {
80:         in_time: Time::to_value(),
81:         in_packet: Packet::to_value(),
82:         out_time: OutTime::to_value(),
83:         out_packet: OutPacket::to_value(),
84:         element_bits: D::BITS,
85:     })
86:     .unwrap_or_else(|message| panic!("{message}"));

95:     /// Begin a tensor unit operation in this context with interleaved tensors.
96:     #[primitive(TuContext::begin_interleaved)]
97:     pub fn begin_interleaved<'l, I: AxisName, D: Scalar, Chip: M, Cluster: M, Slice: M, Element: M>(
98:         &'l mut self,
99:         lhs: DmTensorView<'l, D, Chip, Cluster, Slice, Element>,
100:         rhs: DmTensorView<'l, D, Chip, Cluster, Slice, Element>,
101:     ) -> BeginTensor<'l, { T }, D, Chip, Cluster, Slice, Symbol<I>, Element> {
102:         let mut output = Tensor::<D, m![{ Chip }, { Cluster }, { Slice }, { Symbol<I> }, { Element }]>::zeroed();
103: 
104:         for (i, input) in [lhs, rhs].into_iter().enumerate() {
105:             output
106:                 .view_mut()
107:                 .tile_derived::<Symbol<I>, 1>(i)
108:                 .transpose(input.inner, false);
109:         }
110: 
111:         BeginTensor::new(self, output)

110: /// Resolves transpose-engine hardware parameters.
111: pub fn config_transpose(input: TransposeInput) -> Result<TransposeConfig, TransposeError> {
112:     unsafe {
113:         sys::config_transpose(
114:             &input.in_time,
115:             &input.in_packet,
116:             &input.out_time,
117:             &input.out_packet,
118:             input.element_bits,
119:         )
120:     }
121:     .into_result()
122: }
